newsitem.title: USA: Three Cuban baseball players defect to U.S.
newsitem.headline: Three Cuban baseball players defect to U.S.

text.p: Three Cuban baseball players were heading for the United States on Wednesday after defecting during a tournament in Chiapas, Mexico, a spokesman for Miami sports promoter Jose Cubas said.
The three players, who fled their Cuban team during the night, were named as Roberto Colina, William Ortega and Jesus Ametller.
"Mr. Cubas is going with the three now toward the U.S. border after the three decided to abandon the tournament a little after midnight," spokesman Rene Guim told Reuters.
Colina, 25, Ortega, 21, and Ametller, 22, all played for the club Industriales de La Habana, which was representing Cuba in a tournament of champions in Chiapas.
